## What's new

- **Preset previews:** rest the pointer on a preset in the right-hand panel to see it enlarged, with its size, category, objects and tile libraries.
- **Level light:** set the intensity with the slider or by typing a number. The panel shows the values in Levels.txt, and Reset goes back to them. Moving a "daylight" level (Intensity 0, colour 0,0,0) to a fixed light now starts from white instead of turning the map black.
- **Selection:**
  - Shift+click a selected cell to take it out of the selection; Shift+drag starting on a selected cell takes out a rectangle.
  - Undo and redo keep the selection.
  - With a selection narrowed to one layer (Shift+scroll), Esc goes back to all layers before deselecting.
- **Guide:** the README links to the new online guide.

## Fixes

- **Paste then drag:** pasting with the Paint or Erase tool and dragging no longer paints or erases over what was just pasted.
- **Double-click while painting:** double-clicking with Paint, Erase or Pick no longer selects every matching tile on the map.
- **Selections wiped straight away:** Ctrl+A in object mode, and "Select this cell" from another view, keep their selection instead of losing it immediately.
- **Leftover layer focus:** a Shift+wheel focus on one layer no longer carries over into a new selection, another map, or restored autosaved work.
- **Cut on one layer:** cutting a single layer leaves hidden tiles alone and is named in History.
- **Holding Esc:** holding the key no longer runs straight through to the close-map prompt.
